caption:
Do GLP-1 medicines affect the gallbladder?

Labels of GLP-1 medicines warn of gallbladder problems, including gallstones, and rapid weight loss itself raises that risk. Severe pain in the upper right abdomen needs medical attention. Did you know this? Yes or no.
